lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hi, you're speaking with Daniel from Retailer One. Before we go any further I need to let you know that this call is being recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. Do I have your consent to continue on a recorded line?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yeah, that's fine, go ahead.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you. Can I just confirm I'm speaking with the account holder, Nina Petrova, and that you're authorised to make changes to this account?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, that's me. Nina Petrova, the account's in my name.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Perfect, thanks Nina. And the supply address is 40 Church Street, Richmond, Victoria, three one two one?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That's the one.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Great. So this is about the Secure 12 plan. Before any numbers there's a short statement I'm required to read to you in full.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No worries.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The Default Market Offer is the reference price set by the Australian Energy Regulator. The estimated annual cost of this plan is seven per cent less than the reference price for an average household in your distribution zone. This is an estimate only, and your actual cost will depend on your usage.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Okay, got it.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: A couple of quick questions first. Does anyone at the property rely on life support equipment, and do you hold a concession card?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No to both.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Let me pull the pricing up, bear with me, the system's slow today.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sorry about the wait, thanks for holding.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: On the Secure 12 plan your usage rate is 29.7 cents per kilowatt hour including GST, and the daily supply charge is one hundred and four point nine cents a day.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hang on, is that including GST?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Yes, including GST.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Sorry, I talked over you, go on.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: No worries at all.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The rate isn't locked, we'd give you written notice before any change and you could leave then with no exit fee. Are you happy for me to go ahead?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, let's do it.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: What's the best email for your welcome pack and contract? The cooling-off notice goes there too.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: nina dot petrova at yahoo dot com.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Lovely, got it.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: And just to confirm the NMI off your bill, I've got 6 1 0 3 2 2 1 1 0 0 9. Does that match?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, that matches.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: And this is electricity only, you're not bringing gas across?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Electricity only.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: That's everything. You'll get the welcome pack by email within one business day and your ten business day cooling-off period starts when it lands.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thanks Daniel, bye.
